I thoroughly enjoyed the IV drip treatment and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a wellness boost while traveling.

From the moment I arrived, the staff were friendly, welcoming, and professional. The facility was clean, beautifully maintained, and provided a relaxing atmosphere. I was also impressed by the presentation, attention to detail, and overall quality of service. The pricing was very reasonable for the experience provided. Overall, I would definitely recommend this business and look forward to returning on my next visit.

I was looking for a home IV drip service and came across this place through a Google search. Absolutely no regrets :) booking was really easy, prices are affordable, and the nurses who came to our place were very friendly and professional. I was very hungover from a night out and the hydration IV helped me feel so much better! They also gave a power bank as a gift. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for an IV place to try Rejuvehub!

Amazing experience!  Staff is friendly, knowledgeable with suggestions and the atmosphere is top notch.  Prices very reasonable. I had the detox IV drip and weigh suppressant shot and can report both work amazingly.  It's been a week since the shot and still have no additional cravings for food, especially fried or anything unhealthy.  Even with THC, there is no feeling of the munchies.  Have already easily lost some weight and feel great.

Inside Rejuvehub, the setup is very much like being on a business class flight.  You have your own reclining seat with a private flat screen tv and headphones provided.  It's quiet and soothing.  The session lasted about 30 minutes and can honestly say enjoyed myself so much wish it lasted longer.  Will be doing this again.

Great service and highly effective! Came here for an NAD+ IV therapy and the whole experience was fantastic. The staff was very professional and the environment was relaxing. I could feel a noticeable boost in my energy levels afterwards. Highly recommended!
Excellent services from trained practitioners. The area is comfy and relaxing. I’d recommend for quick vitamins boost in Pattaya
This clinic is very nice, the staff is very helpful and knows what they are doing, come here if you want affordable IV drip. Perfect for hangover or if you feel a bit under the weather.

Everyone was so nice to me. The place was extremely clean. It was such a nice facility as well. I actually fell asleep I was so comfortable. Within an hour after the IV I felt loads better. If you’re trying to save your vacation come here.
After a night of too many beers 🤣 I woke up with a terrible headache and nausea. This place was recommended to me by a friend. The service is professional and fast. Highly recommend. …

Was feeling vary sick due to food poisoning and was worried this sickness would ruin my vacation. Their staff came to my apartment they were beautiful and vary kind to me. They were able to give me an iv drip and thoughtfully talked with me about my concerns. They were beautiful, compassionate and professional

I would like to say thank you for nurse Khun Bee and Khun Honey, they really give absolutely great service and they are so kind,Thanks so much for Rejuvehub Clinic the program for IV was so good and I hope to see the same nurse and use the IV programs from your clinic again..👍🏽💯⭐️ …
Amazing service, very good prices and come to the hotel. Very very lovely nurses and a nice little gift at the end. Will be booking again in two days for my next hangover 555
Great service. Booked a fairly last minute appointment for hotel visit and staff came on time and very professional. Great service and very good price too. Highly recommended.
Excellent service. They offer high-end products and the friendliness and preparation of the staff is superior. Thanks for everything, I will definitely be back
The convenience of having Rejuvehub come right to my hotel is unmatched. Booking online was super easy, and the nurse arrived exactly on time. Provided the best service ever.

Miss Baifern helped me and she was great setting up the needle in my hand, the place is very clean which is very very important, and all the staff was very helpful and professional. Highly recommend it.

My entire experience from the warm and inviting reception and service, to the IV drip process was very professional, and comfortable. The staff are amazing. The IV room was beautifully modern and tranquil. This has been a great experience. I would strongly recommend Rejuvehub IV  to anyone who cares about their health and vitality! I will be coming back again!
Very good clinic for IV Therapie. We were there for NAD+ IV. Very friendly and professionell. We definitly coming back.

I received respectful, professional care and top-quality service at Rejuvehub. The facilities are top-notch. Stepping in from the busy street near the corner of Walking Street into the relaxed lounge was immediately calming.

excellent service feels like VIP when you doing the IV treatment you have a big comfortable love chair and a big screen TV to watch YouTube and they give water and warm towel for you to relax with I highly recommend this IV treatment in Pattaya beach by the walking street sign thank you again for making the experience very comfortable will definitely be back again
Amazing IV Drip, feel better and fresh! Nice quality TV, AC and Headphones! Also offer home service. Very kind ladies also!
Great!! This is my new place to receive my IV Drips.  Very clean and professional.  Nice big TV at each station!!!   Right by walking street

The experience was wonderful. They came to room and gave me an iv right there. Highly recommend. Only 30 minute notice

I had an amazing experience at RejuveHub, the new IV drip clinic in town! Their prices are very affordable compared to other IV drip clinics, which was a big plus for me. The nurses were extremely friendly and professional, and they attached the IV drip so smoothly that I hardly felt anything.

The clinic itself is clean, modern, and relaxing, with comfortable reclining chairs and even a private TV for each customer, which made the whole session super enjoyable. I also loved the attention to detail – they provided a wet towel and a bottle of water without me even asking.

The owner is very enthusiastic and welcoming, which really gives the place a warm and personal touch. I can confidently say this is one of the best wellness experiences I’ve had. Highly recommend RejuveHub to anyone looking for a safe, relaxing, and professional IV drip treatment!

Went here for the iv drips and honestly the service was amazing,  plus the price was good,
